projectDescription: A Windows desktop application that automates typing in the NitroType racing game, featuring configurable typing speed, accuracy simulation, auto-start, and an integrated ad blocker.
keyFeatures: Automated typing simulation up to ~4,000 WPM
Configurable typing rate with variance for natural-looking output
Adjustable accuracy percentage with variance control
Auto Start mode — begins typing as soon as a race loads
Auto New Game — automatically joins the next race after finishing
Auto Nitro Usage — uses nitros on the longest word in a race
God Mode — removes all typing limits and maximizes accuracy
Built-in ad blocker for a cleaner NitroType experience
